reason: Use A's single compact form overall: time with nearby guidance, city search with an explicit selected summary, then Calculate and save. Replace entry controls with confirmation, signs, source details and Done after success; retain secondary Edit and Forget. It offers the clearest recovery and completion with the least navigation overhead. Shorten the saved introduction and prove readiness, scrolling, focus and persistence before treating it as a functional replacement.
limitations: Independent read-only comparison of the six attached sheets and supplied behavioral evidence; no files, prior ratings, other graders or runtime were consulted.

Each state/variant score covers normal and 200% together. A means aesthetic mean; F means functional mean. Component vectors use the same six dimensions as the screen. Null denotes absent state feedback on a static heading or secondary action, not an assumed working interaction.

Shared components, applicable to every respective state: baseline header [6,6.5,7,6,6,6], tabs [7,6.5,7.5,7,7,6.5], orb [6,7,7,6, null,6]. A/B/C header [8,8,8,8, null,8], tabs [7,7,7,6,5,7]. Alternative tabs lack an obvious current-page indicator; mixed icon styles weaken coherence. Orb typography score concerns its relationship to the Ask label.

Prototype feedback scores assess visible messages and state composition only. Lookup, validation, calculation, persistence, draft retention, editing, forgetting, focus, announcements, keyboard operation and motion remain unverified for A/B/C. Their fixture results demonstrate no successful calculation.

Offscreen controls at 200% are a composition cost, not proof of inaccessibility. Screenshots cannot establish whether scrolling fully exposes them above navigation; no inaccessible-control gate was inferred solely from cropping.
Baseline's supplied browser checks support its implemented behavior but do not erase its generic error, displaced saved result or stale post-forgetting confirmation.

No variant demonstrates the required browser-stage A≥9 and F≥9 across every screen and meaningful component. Physical iPhone and assistive-technology proof remains separate and unverified; these are provisional composition grades, not native certification.
